@@U00265@@
A lovely dream—until he fades from view.
But where do I find them, where, those earthly wings,
companions to the wings of the spirit?
Yet everywhere, in each of us,
we harbor the desire to rise above,
to surge, to soar along,
when high in the blue immensity of heaven
the lark pipes its trilling song;
when high above pine-clad crags
the eagle hovers on wings wide spread;
when at evening the crane flaps slowly homeward
over sleepy ponds and marches.

@@U00267@@
Yes, well,
I’ve had my aberrant moments, too,
but I must confess P’ve never felt such an urge.
You see one field and forest you've seen them all,
and soon enough, too.
And as for envying a bird its flight,
no no, not me, glad to say.
How differently the spirit’s pleasures
bear us from book to book,
from page to page!
How bright and beautiful winter nights are then,
every limb snug and warm.
Ah, and then you unroll an ancient parchment
and heaven spreads out before you!

@@U00269@@
Yes, and this is the force that drives you.
You know only the one urge,
never strive to know the other!
Ach!
Two souls cohabit in my breast,
each one struggling to tear itself from the other!
The one, like a coarse lover,
translation:
@@U00265@@
一个美丽的梦——直到他从视野中消失。
但我在哪里可以找到它们，在哪里，那些尘世的翅膀，
灵魂之翼的同伴？
然而无处不在，在我们每个人的内心，
我们怀有超越的愿望，
汹涌澎湃，飞翔，
当在蔚蓝无边的天堂高处时
云雀发出颤抖的歌声；
当高出松树覆盖的峭壁时
雄鹰张开翅膀盘旋；
当傍晚时分，起重机缓缓地扑向回家的方向
越过沉睡的池塘和游行。

@@U00267@@
是的，好吧，
我也有过不正常的时刻
但我必须承认 P 从未有过这样的冲动。
你看到了一片田野和森林，你已经看到了它们全部，
很快，也是。
至于羡慕鸟儿的飞行，
不不，不是我，很高兴地说。
精神上的快乐有多么不同
带着我们从一本书到另一本书，
从一页到另一页！
那时的冬夜是多么明亮美丽，
每一个肢体都舒适而温暖。
啊，然后你展开一张古老的羊皮纸
天堂在你面前展开！

@@U00269@@
是的，这就是驱动你的力量。
你只知道一种冲动，
永远不要努力去了解对方！
啊！
两个灵魂在我胸中同居，
每个人都在努力将自己从另一个人身上撕下来！
那个人，就像一个粗俗的情人，
